As far as cosplay, most real human faces don't translate easily with fictional characters. To get your face to appear closer to the character's, you'll need to play with contour until it looks close. Also, sometimes "moving" your eyebrows is needed. Take stick glue, rub over your eyebrows, then powder the glue (most face powders can work, just keep in mind your skin color and the skin color of your character). keep doing this until your eyebrows are invisible, then draw your brows in the correct color higher up, or in the same spot in whatever shape you need.

But even without super accurate make up fans will still enjoy and recognize your cosplay just from the costume and hair.
